newsitem.title: UK: Cambridge Antibody Technology to float.
newsitem.headline: Cambridge Antibody Technology to float.

text.p: Cambridge Antibody Technology Group Plc said on Monday that it was to float on the stock market in the next few months.
Sources close to the company said the listing should raise between 30 and 35 million stg via an institutional placing, valuing the company at around 85 million stg.
In a statement CAT said Kleinwort Benson Ltd was acting as a sponsor to the flotation and Cazenove & Co as broker.
The company, which has been operating since 1990, specialises in using human anitibodies both to discover and develop new drugs.
CAT already has projects underway in the fields of inflammation, fibrosis, cancer and obesity, and said two drugs from these categories were expected to enter human clinical trials this year.
The group's technology, which it said can greatly speed up the process of drug discovery, has already been licensed to a large number of major players, including Pfizer Inc and Eli Lilly & Co.
CAT said its goal was to take new drugs through Phase I and Phase II clinical trials itself before seeking partners for late-stage trials, registration and marketing.
